dialogues.jp: そういえば、少しだけ気になることがある。
dialogues.en: There's something on my mind......
dialogues.text: There's something on my mind......

dialogues.jp:
このテスト期間中、はたして、萌先輩は寝ずに
過ごせているのだろうか？
dialogues.en:
I wonder if Moe-sempai has been staying awake during the
exam week.
dialogues.text:
I wonder if Moe-sempai has been staying awake during the
exam week.

dialogues.jp: 「……気になる」
dialogues.en: "......I wonder."
dialogues.text: "......I wonder."

dialogues.jp:
試験の回答や明日のテストの予測などで盛り上
がるクラスメイトを軽く見渡す。
dialogues.en:
I looked around the classroom as my classmates talked about
how they did on the exam, and what they thought about the
exam tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
I looked around the classroom as my classmates talked about
how they did on the exam, and what they thought about the
exam tomorrow.

dialogues.jp:
眞子の姿はない。｛さすが／流石｝に今日は帰ったのかもし
れない。
dialogues.en: I don't see Mako in the class. I guess she went back home.
dialogues.text: I don't see Mako in the class. I guess she went back home.

dialogues.jp:
眞子がいたら、萌先輩の教室まで連れていって
もらおうと思ったのだが。
dialogues.en: I was hoping she could take me to Moe-sempai's classroom.
dialogues.text: I was hoping she could take me to Moe-sempai's classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「しゃーない」
dialogues.en: "Oh well......"
dialogues.text: "Oh well......"

dialogues.jp:
鞄を持って席を立ち、残ったやつらに軽く挨拶
して廊下に出た。
dialogues.en:
I picked up my bag and waved to my friends, then walked out
to the hallway.
dialogues.text:
I picked up my bag and waved to my friends, then walked out
to the hallway.

dialogues.jp: 「明日は土曜日だってのに１日中テストかぁ」
dialogues.en: "Tomorrow's Saturday, but we have exams all day......"
dialogues.text: "Tomorrow's Saturday, but we have exams all day......"

dialogues.jp: 「……かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "......What a pain."
dialogues.text: "......What a pain."

dialogues.jp:
スケジュールを決めたやつを呪いつつ、人気の
少ない廊下を本校校舎へと向かう。
dialogues.en:
I cursed whoever made the exam schedule and headed toward
the main campus.
dialogues.text:
I cursed whoever made the exam schedule and headed toward
the main campus.

dialogues.speaker: School girl
dialogues.jp: 「水越さん、起きて」
dialogues.en: "Wake up, Mizukoshi-san."
dialogues.text: "Wake up, Mizukoshi-san."

dialogues.jp:
周りの机が全て教室の後ろに下げられているな
か、萌先輩の座る机だけがポツンと教室の真ん
中に取り残されていた。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai's desk was left in the center of the classroom,
while all the other desks were pulled to the back of the
room.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai's desk was left in the center of the classroom,
while all the other desks were pulled to the back of the
room.

dialogues.jp:
ホウキを持った女の子が萌先輩の肩をゆすって
いるが、先輩はスヤスヤと気持ちよさそうな寝
顔を浮かべ続けている。
dialogues.en:
A female student with a broom in her hand was shaking
Moe-sempai's shoulder, but she was sleeping peacefully.
dialogues.text:
A female student with a broom in her hand was shaking
Moe-sempai's shoulder, but she was sleeping peacefully.

dialogues.jp:
考えてみれば｛このひと／萌先輩｝が長時間、起きていられる
はずがない。
dialogues.en: I knew there was no way she could stay up for a long time.
dialogues.text: I knew there was no way she could stay up for a long time.

dialogues.jp:
恐らくテストを受けている最中に、いつも通り
に眠ってしまったのだろう。
dialogues.en: I assume she fell asleep during the exam.
dialogues.text: I assume she fell asleep during the exam.

dialogues.jp:
背筋を伸ばし……目を閉じて……シャーペンを
構えている。
dialogues.en:
She's sitting up straight with a pencil in her hand......
but her eyes are closed.
dialogues.text:
She's sitting up straight with a pencil in her hand......
but her eyes are closed.

dialogues.jp: 「そして現在に至ると」
dialogues.en: "She's probably been sleeping since then."
dialogues.text: "She's probably been sleeping since then."

dialogues.jp:
もしかしたら、寝ながら答えを書いていたのか
も知れない。
dialogues.en:
It's possible she may have been taking the exam in her
sleep.
dialogues.text:
It's possible she may have been taking the exam in her
sleep.

dialogues.jp: 心眼？　それとも自動書記状態？
dialogues.en: Can she see with her mind's eyes?
dialogues.text: Can she see with her mind's eyes?

dialogues.jp:
教室内に入り、萌先輩の席の横に立つ。先輩の
肩を揺らしていた女の子が俺を見る。
dialogues.en:
I went inside the classroom and stood beside her. The girl
who was shaking her shoulder looked at me.
dialogues.text:
I went inside the classroom and stood beside her. The girl
who was shaking her shoulder looked at me.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……萌先輩？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ん……ふぁぁ……」
俺の声に反応するように、萌先輩の目が開く。
dialogues.en: She opened her eyes as if she reacted to my voice.
dialogues.text: She opened her eyes as if she reacted to my voice.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ……朝倉くん、こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Oh...... Asakura-kun. Hello."
dialogues.text: "Oh...... Asakura-kun. Hello."

dialogues.jp: 目を擦りながら俺を見上げ、ニッコリと微笑む。
dialogues.en: She looked up at me and rubbed her eyes, then gave a smile.
dialogues.text: She looked up at me and rubbed her eyes, then gave a smile.

dialogues.speaker: Male student
dialogues.jp: 「すげぇぇ！？」
dialogues.en: "Wow!!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!!"

dialogues.speaker: Schoolgirl
dialogues.jp: 「すごい！　どうして！？」
dialogues.en: "Wow! How did you do that?"
dialogues.text: "Wow! How did you do that?"

dialogues.jp:
教室に残っていた学生から、なぜか、どよめき
の声が上がる。
dialogues.en: The students in the classroom started making noise.
dialogues.text: The students in the classroom started making noise.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……みんなどうしたんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... What's wrong, everyone?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... What's wrong, everyone?"

dialogues.jp:
周囲のどよめきのなか、萌先輩だけがひとり、
きょとんとしている。
dialogues.en:
As her classmates murmured, Moe-sempai remained there with a
surprised look on her face.
dialogues.text:
As her classmates murmured, Moe-sempai remained there with a
surprised look on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「……みんな萌先輩が起きて喜んでるんですよ」
dialogues.en: "......They're glad that you're awake, Moe-sempai."
dialogues.text: "......They're glad that you're awake, Moe-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「萌先輩、とりあえず出ましょう。掃除の邪魔
　になってますから」
dialogues.en:
"Let's get out of here, Moe-sempai. You're in the way of the
clean up crew."
dialogues.text:
"Let's get out of here, Moe-sempai. You're in the way of the
clean up crew."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい。ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, yes. I'm sorry......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, yes. I'm sorry......"

dialogues.jp:
慌てたように立ち上がり、その机を、掃除当番
の女の子が運んでいく……手慣れた感じだな。
dialogues.en:
As she quickly stood up, a girl took her desk to the
back...... It seems like they go through this all the time.
dialogues.text:
As she quickly stood up, a girl took her desk to the
back...... It seems like they go through this all the time.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "Let's go then."
dialogues.text: "Let's go then."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 歩き出した俺の後について、先輩も歩き出す。
dialogues.en: As I started walking, she followed behind me.
dialogues.text: As I started walking, she followed behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「起こしてくれてありがとうございました」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for waking me up."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for waking me up."

dialogues.jp: 廊下に出たところで、深々とお辞儀をされる。
dialogues.en: When we came out to the hallway, she bowed at me politely.
dialogues.text: When we came out to the hallway, she bowed at me politely.

dialogues.en: "No problem......"
dialogues.text: "No problem......"

dialogues.jp:
いつから寝ていたのか気になるところだけど……
｛き／訊｝かないでおこう。
dialogues.en:
I wonder how long she was asleep...... but I'm not going to
ask.
dialogues.text:
I wonder how long she was asleep...... but I'm not going to
ask.

dialogues.jp: 今さらだし。
dialogues.en: It's too late anyway.
dialogues.text: It's too late anyway.

dialogues.jp:
それに、目的であった萌先輩の試験風景はもう
聞かなくても理解出来た。
dialogues.en: Without asking, I already know how she did during the exam.
dialogues.text: Without asking, I already know how she did during the exam.

dialogues.jp: 「早く帰りましょう。明日も試験だし」
dialogues.en: "Let's go home. We have more exams tomorrow too."
dialogues.text: "Let's go home. We have more exams tomorrow too."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 一緒に並んで歩き始める。
dialogues.en: We started walking together.
dialogues.text: We started walking together.

dialogues.jp:
どの教室も、掃除当番以外、ほとんど残ってい
ない。
dialogues.en: Most of the students were gone from the classrooms.
dialogues.text: Most of the students were gone from the classrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そう言えば、いつの間に今日の試験は終わっ
　たんでしょう……？」
dialogues.en: "I wonder what time the exam ended today......"
dialogues.text: "I wonder what time the exam ended today......"

dialogues.jp:
隣で首を傾げる萌先輩にあえて答えず、そのま
ま進んでいく。
dialogues.en:
As she tilted her head, I continued to walk without
answering.
dialogues.text:
As she tilted her head, I continued to walk without
answering.

dialogues.jp:
同じクラスになるようなことが、なければいい
けど……。
dialogues.en: I hope she doesn't fail and end up in my class......
dialogues.text: I hope she doesn't fail and end up in my class......

dialogues.jp: （洒落にならんな……）
dialogues.en: (It's not funny......)
dialogues.text: (It's not funny......)

dialogues.jp: ◆心眼◆
dialogues.en: ◆Mind's eyes◆
dialogues.text: ◆Mind's eyes◆

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩の様子を見に行くと、例によってという
か、眠っていた。
dialogues.en:
When I went to check on how Moe-sempai was doing, she was
sleeping just as I expected.
dialogues.text:
When I went to check on how Moe-sempai was doing, she was
sleeping just as I expected.

dialogues.jp:
恐らくテストを受けている最中に、いつも通り
に眠ってしまったのだろう。
dialogues.en: I assume she fell asleep during the exam.
dialogues.text: I assume she fell asleep during the exam.

dialogues.jp:
俺は萌先輩を起こすと、一緒に教室を出ていっ
たのだった。
dialogues.en: I woke her up, and we left the classroom together.
dialogues.text: I woke her up, and we left the classroom together.
